guarantees.claim: rnd_eq_end is driven high when the round counter equals MaxRound-1, else low.
The PRIM_FLOP_SPARSE_FSM instance updates keccak_st with keccak_st_d on each clock edge and drives sparse_fsm_error_o high if keccak_st takes an invalid encoding.

assumptions.claim: clear_i must be asserted with a valid mubi4_t encoding to trigger internal state clearing.
assumptions.cond: when a clear operation is intended
assumptions.risk: If clear_i is not properly driven or decoded, internal state (digest/secret) may not be zeroized, causing data leakage.

assumptions.claim: lc_escalate_en_i must be asserted to disable sensitive operations in threat scenarios; the module assumes that when escalated, safe state logic will be enforced elsewhere.
assumptions.cond: when life cycle escalation is active
assumptions.risk: If escalation input is ignored or not connected, the module may continue operating during attacks.

assumptions.claim: valid_i must not be asserted unless ready_o is high; the external producer must obey this contract.
assumptions.risk: If valid_i is asserted while not ready, data could be lost or internal state corrupted.

uncertain_points.claim: Control signals (update_storage, rst_storage, xor_message, phase_sel, round increment/reset, complete_d) are declared but not driven in this region; their generation logic is outside the chunk.
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect or missing logic on these signals could break the Keccak round sequence, causing incorrect digest or security bypass.

uncertain_points.claim: The mechanism by which clear_i triggers state clearing (rst_storage) is not visible; rst_storage is a declared signal with no driver in this region.
uncertain_points.risk: If rst_storage is not properly driven by clear_i, the clear operation may fail to zeroize the state, leading to data remnant exposure.

uncertain_points.claim: Parameter DInWidth is noted as 'currently only 64bit supported', but no parameter validation is visible. Setting DInWidth to other values could cause incorrect address/data alignment.
uncertain_points.risk: Width mismatches may lead to functional failure or security vulnerabilities in message feed.
